title: Crews of Lancaster 4103 and Oxford LB415
squadron: No 5 Lancaster finishing school./ No 5 Group/ Royal Air Force Bomber Command
memorial_details: Square brass plaque mounted on a wooden board, with white, incised lettering. Rectangular paper memorial with red and black typescript mounted in narrow, black, glazed frame.
inscription: Brass plaque: In memory of/ the crews of two Royal Air Force aircraft/ who lost their lives in the mid-air collision/ above Screveton at 16.30 hours on Friday April 14th 1944/ Avro Lancaster Mark I serial number W4103/ of/ No 5 Lancaster finishing school./ NO 5 Group/ Royal Air Force Bomber Command/ Royal Air Force Syerston/ Nottinghamshire./ (Names)/ Airspeed Oxford Mark I Serial Number LB415/ No 93 Operational Training Unit/ No.7 Group/Royal Air Force Bomber Command/ Royal Air Force Wymeswold/ Leicestershire./ (Names) Paper memorial: similar to plaque, but minor differences describing No 93 OTU and mispelling of names (see image)
